procedure: Bind audit scope and inspect workbook dependencies.
Trace material formulas, units and financial control identities.
Test relevant edge cases and record actual recalculation/render coverage.
Report findings or perform already authorized versioned repairs and targeted rechecks.

acceptance.expectation: Findings name sheet/cell/range, input hash, evidence, expected/observed difference and consequence.
Financial controls and relevant model-specific checks have quantified residuals or recorded untested scope.
Author/independent review and structural/arithmetic/native/render checks remain separate.
Repairs preserve original versions and recheck affected calculations; no native recalculation is inferred from caches.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction
